headline: India's Tax Department Flags Gaps in Foreign Investor Tax IDs, Seeks Rule Changes
summary: India's income tax department flagged gaps in foreign investor tax identification numbers and sought account-opening rule changes to improve information sharing with foreign tax authorities.
why: Enhanced compliance and tax transparency regulations affect onboarding procedures and capital flows from foreign institutional investors.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Stricter tax ID verification requirements modify administrative procedures for foreign entities investing in India.
